u0: Normal task progress: there is no unresolved box-fall recovery. Keep or obtain the box in your hands and move toward the exit; stepping onto the exit only succeeds while holding the box. If the box slips from your hands, immediately switch to recovering it.
u1: Immediate box-recovery state after the box has fallen. Your next action must be the successful pickup of the fallen box; do not move away or do anything else first. Once holding the box again away from the exit, resume normal progress. If you remain empty-handed after the fall, you enter terminal lost-box failure; reaching the exit while holding the box completes the task.
u2: Terminal lost-box failure. This state means the box condition has failed: you reached the exit without holding the box, or after a fall you did not recover it immediately. No productive objective remains and success can no longer be reached.
u3: Terminal success: you have reached the exit while holding the box. The task is complete, and no further action is needed.
